aggregation: video aggregates are the mean of scene metrics
temporal aggregates are kept separate from spatial objective
failureHandling: non-finite output, GPU error, invalid paired sample, or missing window rejects the evaluation
failure after metric exposure invalidates the selection cycle
no failure is converted into a numeric score
normalization: regional values are normalized by region population
signedSemantics: positive overshoot and negative undershoot remain separate diagnostics
primary objective uses declared absolute/log terms, not signed cancellation

policyDefinition.explicitGammaBehavior: metadata gamma finite and > 0; metadata authoritative
policyDefinition.linearBehavior: encoded signal is already linear; metadata authoritative
policyDefinition.sRGBBehavior: inverse IEC 61966-2-1 piecewise transfer; metadata authoritative

failurePolicy: decode, alignment, scene, temporal, path, or hash failure rejects the plan
no implicit frame selection or policy fallback at evaluator entry
non-finite preparation values reject before plan sealing
preparationDefinition.metadataInterpretationSemantics: SDRInputInterpretationResolver.resolve; source transfer metadata and untagged fallback are explicit
preparationDefinition.sceneFrameSelectionSemantics: SceneDetector.v6; sequencePosition-domain; accepted representatives are sealed in V6ScenePlan
preparationDefinition.sourceGridLuminanceSemantics: OfflinePixelSampler.linearLumaGrid; source-grid luminance is computed before objective access

failurePolicy: infrastructure failure before metric exposure may rerun the same sealed configuration
metric exposure followed by failure invalidates this selection cycle
no threshold, metric, policy, or search-space change after Validation exposure
hardGates: finite outputs and no GPU error
transfer, range, and metadata resolution match the selected policy
transform monotonicity and exact black/white anchors
temporal sequence and precision checks pass
searchDefinition.parameterRepresentation: finite IEEE-754 values; canonical decimal JSON; lexicographic parameter-name order
safetyGates: no clipping or near-black safety violation
selectionOrdering: temporal stability, clipping, and near-black safety break ties
